europe_now.title: Russia adjusts drone tactics in Ukraine
europe_now.summary: Russia is modifying its drone warfare tactics in Ukraine, introducing faster and more lethal Shahed systems. This adjustment reflects an ongoing evolution in the conflict's military dynamics.

sources.headline: Russia is adapting its drone-warfare strategy, with faster and deadlier ‘Shaheds’ (Ukraine Battlefield update, Day 1,636)

europe_now.title: France investigates election disinformation
europe_now.summary: French authorities have opened an inquiry into disinformation efforts directed at 2027 election candidates. The investigation aims to determine the extent and sources of the alleged influence operations.

sources.headline: France probes disinfo campaigns targeting 2027 election candidates

top_stories.title: Granada earthquake injures three
top_stories.summary: A seismic event struck Granada, Spain, causing damage to historic structures and injuring three individuals. Emergency services responded to provide medical assistance and assess the impact.

sources.headline: Earthquake rocks Spain's historic Granada, injuring three

top_stories.title: Thousands of minors stranded in Ceuta
top_stories.summary: In the Spanish enclave of Ceuta, thousands of unaccompanied minors are living on the streets without access to basic sanitation or shelter. Authorities and aid organizations have reported heightened risks of exploitation and abuse for these children.

sources.headline: No toilets, no shelter, little protection. In Ceuta, DW finds thousands of minors living alone on the streets.

top_stories.title: UK pledges full support to Ukraine
top_stories.summary: UK officials have declared full support for Ukraine following a recent Russian drone warning. The statement underscores continued British backing amid escalating regional tensions.

sources.headline: UK 'supports Ukraine 100%', Burnham says, after Russia's drone warning
